name: Ransomware in the data centers
injects: Hour 0: VMs in both data centers show a ransom note. Domain admin accounts were used.
Hour 2: Payroll Friday. 6,200 business clients expect payroll to land today.
Hour 12: A reporter asks whether customer balances are accurate.

name: Core banking DB corruption
injects: Hour 0: A bad patch corrupts ledger rows. Replication copies the damage to DC2 within seconds.
Hour 3: Branches report wrong balances.
Hour 8: Finance asks if month-end close can proceed.

name: Primary data center power loss
injects: Hour 0: Utility power and both generators fail at the primary site.
Hour 1: Card declines spike across all regions.
Hour 6: The facility team estimates 48 hours.

name: Cloud region East outage
injects: Hour 0: The cloud provider confirms a regional outage in East.
Hour 1: Fraud scoring is unavailable; card authorizations are waiting.
Hour 4: Mobile app reviews spike.

name: Active Directory corruption
injects: Hour 0: A bad replication event deletes thousands of AD objects in every domain controller.
Hour 1: Staff can't sign in. Internal DNS answers fail.
Hour 6: The identity team starts forest recovery.

name: Cloud SSO and MFA outage
injects: Hour 0: SSO provider outage. No one can sign in to cloud apps.
Hour 1: Online banking login fails for customers.
Hour 3: Contact center agents can't reach CRM.

name: HSM cluster failure
injects: Hour 0: A firmware update bricks both HSM units.
Hour 0: PIN verification and wire signing stop.
Hour 4: The vendor ships replacements; keys must be restored from smart cards.

name: Card network link down
injects: Hour 0: Card network connectivity drops on both circuits.
Hour 1: Weekend shoppers see declines.

name: ACH operator outage
injects: Hour 0: The ACH operator delays all settlement windows.
Hour 2: Business clients call about payroll.

name: Wire network outage near cutoff
injects: Hour 0: Wire network messaging unavailable.
Hour 3: Real estate closings waiting on wires.
Hour 4: Same-day cutoff passes.

name: DDoS on digital channels
injects: Hour 0: Traffic spikes 40x on online banking.
Hour 2: The DDoS provider is scrubbing; some traffic still drops.

name: Fiber cut at the primary site
injects: Hour 0: Construction crew cuts the street conduit.
Hour 0: Both ISPs report circuits down. They were sold as diverse.
Hour 3: Payroll files from clients can't reach file transfer.

name: Internal DNS failure
injects: Hour 0: A bad zone push breaks internal name resolution.
Hour 1: Core banking and payments can't find their services.

name: Service bus failure
injects: Hour 0: The enterprise service bus stops processing.
Hour 2: Payments queue; core banking can't post.

name: SAN array failure
injects: Hour 0: The primary SAN controller pair fails.
Hour 1: Everything on VM cluster DC1 is down; failover to DC2 starts.

name: Backup console compromised
injects: Hour 0: Attacker deletes backup jobs and encrypts the payments DB.
Hour 1: The vault copies are intact, but the console must be rebuilt first.

name: Fraud platform outage
injects: Hour 0: Kubernetes East fails; fraud scoring stops.
Hour 0: Decide: approve cards without scoring, or decline?

name: Branch network outage
injects: Hour 0: SD-WAN controller fails; 62 branches lose connection.
Hour 1: Branch managers switch to offline teller mode.

name: Expired API certificate
injects: Hour 0: The API gateway certificate expires in both regions.
Hour 0: Failover doesn't help; the same certificate is used everywhere.

name: Telephony carrier outage
injects: Hour 0: Inbound calls fail.
Hour 2: Social media complaints rise; customers can't report lost cards.
